description: Trap: preceding-year net profit exactly Rs5,00,00,000 (revenue 60,00,00,000 + other income 0 - expenses 55,00,00,000 = 5,00,00,000): s.135 says 'five crore or more' -> CSR applies (warn roc.csr-applicability). Obligation = 2% x average of (5,00,00,000 + 4,20,00,000 + 3,10,00,000)/3 = 2% x 4,10,00,000 = Rs8,20,000 (82000000 paise). Small company: preceding-year turnover Rs60 cr > verified Rs40 cr limit (2022 Rules; paid-up 10L is within Rs4 cr) -> NOT small -> MGT-7 applies, but MGT-7A declared -> block roc.annual-return-form; smallCompany 0, mgt7a 0. Under the UNVERIFIED Rs10 cr / Rs100 cr limits (from 01-12-2025, not applied) 10L and 60 cr would be small -> classification differs -> warn roc.small-company-pending-verification. Current year: revenue 70 cr, other income 0, expenses 64 cr, tax 1.5 cr -> PBT 6 cr (6000000000 paise); reserves 9,45,00,000 so equity 9,55,00,000 (9550000000 paise); liabilities 5L + 12L + 3L = 20L; assets fixed 4,00,00,000 + inventories 2,00,00,000 + receivables 3,00,00,000 + cash 65,00,000 + other 10,00,000 = 9,75,00,000 (9750000000 paise) = equity 9,55,00,000 + 20,00,000 -> diff 0. Net worth / turnover thresholds: preceding net worth 10L + 4,90,00,000 = 5 cr (< 500 cr), turnover 60 cr (< 1,000 cr) -> only net profit triggers CSR. Dates and fees unchanged: AGM due 30-09-2026, held 25-09-2026; AOC-4 24-10-2026; MGT-7 23-11-2026; filing 15-10-2026 -> no fee; normal fee Rs500; auditor year 4; DPT-3 applicable, filed.
